name: bile_splash
for: road bloater belch (where the gout lands)
notes: The gout hits the floor: a crown of thick bile tongues splays up (~0.35 m) and collapses, droplets and dark chunks fly and land, then it spreads into a lumpy puddle ~0.8 m wide with a faint sickly fume and glints. Anchor = landing point on the ground (feet). Ends on the full puddle so bile_pool can take over seamlessly.
